purpose.zh-Hant: 讀懂分佈、反推頻數，並檢查合併與變換對統計量的影響。
purpose.en: Read distributions, recover frequencies and check how combining or transforming data affects statistics.

prerequisites.zh-Hant: 四則運算、百分比、排序與基本代數。
prerequisites.en: Arithmetic, percentages, ordering and basic algebra.

scopeNote.zh-Hant: 本頁提供基本方法導讀及現有題庫入口；進階分支與完整圖解會繼續補充，並非完整課綱或全章筆記。
scopeNote.en: This is a foundational method guide and an entry to the published bank. Advanced branches and complete visual explanations are still being developed; this is not a complete syllabus or chapter note.

title.en: Read the data and displays carefully

intro.zh-Hant: 先找樣本數、變量、單位、組界及頻數。平均數、中位數與眾數描述的中心不同；比較分佈時須同時考慮中心與離散。
intro.en: Identify sample size, variable, units, class boundaries and frequencies. Mean, median and mode describe different centres. Compare both centre and spread.

trigger.zh-Hant: 排序後才找中位數及四分位數；幹葉圖先讀 key，框線圖先辨認五數概括。
trigger.en: Order observations before finding the median and quartiles. Read a stem-and-leaf key and identify the five-number summary of a box plot.

trap.zh-Hant: 分組數據用組中值估計平均數，不代表每個原值都等於組中值。
trap.en: A grouped-data mean estimated with class midpoints does not mean all observations equal those midpoints.

intro.zh-Hant: 反推題先列總頻數及加權總和；中位數條件涉及排序位置，不能只列平均數方程。
intro.en: Start reconstruction with total frequency and weighted sum. Median conditions constrain ordered positions, not just the mean equation.

trigger.zh-Hant: 未知頻數通常要是非負整數；同時檢查排序、中位數位置及題目附加條件。
trigger.en: Unknown frequencies normally need to be nonnegative integers. Also check ordering, median positions and additional conditions.

trap.zh-Hant: 聯立方程的根可能不符合頻數或次序；必須回到原數據定義篩選。
trap.en: Solutions of the equations can violate frequency or ordering constraints. Filter them against the original data.

intro.zh-Hant: 合併平均數按樣本數加權；每項變成 y=ax+b 時，平均數跟同一變換，標準差乘以 |a|。
intro.en: A combined mean is weighted by group sizes. If y=ax+b for every observation, the mean follows the same transformation and the standard deviation is multiplied by |a|.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先分清是整組變換還是加入／刪除某個數據；兩者不能用同一規則。
trigger.en: Distinguish transforming every observation from adding or deleting observations; they require different rules.

trap.zh-Hant: 平移不改變標準差；負倍數不能令標準差變成負數。合併標準差也不能直接取加權平均。
trap.en: Translation leaves standard deviation unchanged. A negative scale factor cannot make it negative. Combined standard deviations are not obtained by a simple weighted average.
